name: knowledge-compiler
description: Give AI coding agents persistent, local memory across sessions: compile decks, PDFs, docs, and chats into an OKF v0.3 Markdown wiki and 3D WebGL graph.
suggestedPrompts: Set up a local knowledge vault in ./vault and save what we learned in this session
Turn a PDF, slide deck, or folder of docs into linked Markdown notes in my knowledge vault
Audit my knowledge vault for broken links, stale facts, and orphan notes
